scores.why: The source defines a coherent editorial system, but the creative sheet underuses desktop width and the role legend contradicts its own colour cue.

Use var(--red) instead of var(--ink) so the red-pen symbol matches its label and the later human decisions.
Move the artwork immediately after the A/B propositions and concise correction summary, ahead of the extended brief.

scores.why: Headline tokens, model IDs, stage durations, 17 checks, conflicts and sign-off match the artifacts, while assumptions and the specified repository discrepancies are disclosed.
The dependency-free source includes accessible navigation and responsive rules, but read-all mode does not synchronize navigation with the sheet being read.

fixes.change: Update the current sheet as the reader scrolls in read-all mode so Contents, Next and Back reflect the visible sheet.
Add a concise keyboard hint for Left/Right navigation and Escape to close Contents.

scores.why: The illustration and can are appealing and honestly labelled, but the can’s wordmark spacing and the acknowledged vertical-layout problem prevent an unchanged release.

fixes.change: Increase the gap between the yellow symbol and the product wordmark to at least one wordmark height, as required by the brand guidelines.

overall: Strong evidence discipline; tighten sheets 9–10, expose the complete deliverable and finish the creative layouts. Hash matched; no repository files changed. Chrome exited before screenshots were produced, so layout and UX assessments are source-based; the embedded can image was inspected directly.
